messages:
amy: Customer BrightShop (private VPC, tenant=tenant-bright-123) reports that the Usage / Requests charts in Console are showing "no data" since ~2026-03-15 02:00 UTC. They can still make inference calls (200 OK), but per-tenant graphs are empty. Attaching proxy logs and a sample request we captured.

amy: sample curl from their app (sanitized):
```
curl -i -X POST https://gateway.private.redwood/batch 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}'
```

amy: note — their request doesn't include X-Tenant-ID header after our gateway (they claim it used to). logs show upstream request headers: Authorization, content-type, user-agent only.

jon: thanks @amy. Can you paste a request trace id or any request-id from the logs? need to look at ingress filter. Also pinging @li (ingress/infra).

amy: trace_id=trace-0a1b2c3d, req_id=req-99f2. From the app -> gateway we see X-Tenant-ID present, but from gateway -> internal-proxy it's missing. So something is stripping/whitelisting headers in the gateway rewrite step.

li: looking now. Quick hypothesis: recent Envoy header whitelist update (rolled yesterday) replaced downstream header preservation with an explicit allowed list. I pulled the live config and see allowed_headers doesn't include "x-tenant-id".

li: relevant snippet from envoy filter (live):
```yaml
request_headers_to_remove: []
allowed_headers: 
  - authorization
  - content-type
  - user-agent
  # x-tenant-id missing here -> header gets dropped by header sanitization filter
```

li: follow-up: our metrics ingestion relies on an upstream header (X-Tenant-ID) to attribute Prometheus-style metrics and to scope queries in the Console for private VPCs. If the header is missing we classify as "unknown_tenant" and private-console queries intentionally filter unknown tenants out for security/isolation. That explains empty charts.

jon: makes sense. Two immediate options: (1) hotfix the envoys to allow x-tenant-id through the whitelist, or (2) inject tenant header on the gateway using JWT claim mapping as a fallback. Hotfix is faster.

amy: customer on paid Dedicated tier, very sensitive. Can we do hotfix?

li: will open a patch to add x-tenant-id to allowed_headers, test in staging, then roll to prod. Will also add an integration check to catch header drops next time.

deploy-bot: Started rollout: infra/ingress/allow-tenant-header (patch id infra-allow-tenant-2026-03-15-01). Progress: staged -> 1/3 prod -> 0/3.

li: patch applied to prod gateway fleet, propagation in progress. Expect metrics to reappear within ~5-15 minutes as pipeline starts receiving tenant-qualified metrics again.

amy: monitoring console now. @maya-cs is on the customer call.

maya-cs: on call — confirming with BrightShop. 12 minutes after the patch their private usage charts just populated for the 24h window. Customer says historic points are still missing earlier than 02:00 UTC (we'll look into retention/backfill separately) but live/near-real-time metrics are back. :tada:

jon: root cause = ingress header sanitization whitelist omitted x-tenant-id after recent change. Remediation = add header to allowed list + add integration test. Longer-term: add fallback header injection from validated JWT so tenant attribution doesn't rely solely on forwarded header.

amy: I'll follow up with customer, log incident, and create a postmortem ticket to eng-infra to cover similar headers (x-tenant-org, x-tenant-region) in case of future drops.

li: filed infra ticket INFRA-3219 for tests + JWT mapping work.

amy: closing the support thread once CS confirms. Thanks for fast response y'all. :heart:
